visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A fair-skinned woman with brown hair tied back, wearing a bright red ruffled bikini, stands on a sunny white sand beach with turquoise water. She smiles broadly with her mouth open, squinting against the sun. Behind her, a young boy in dark swim trunks walks toward the water. Yellow and red text overlays appear on the screen with white radiation lines. (2) The woman continues talking, then suddenly screams with her mouth wide and arms outstretched. She performs a staged fall onto the sand as the camera angle tilts. A yellow warning triangle icon with a '!' appears. (3) The scene shifts to the woman wearing a pink floral dress with a cherry pattern. She is outdoors with palm trees and a resort deck in the background. She gestures with her hands near her face. (4) Footage of the ocean floor follows, showing a light gray stingray swimming over green seagrass. (5) The woman appears in a black bikini on a deck over the water, holding her fingers up in 'OK' signs near her ears. (6) Back in the pink dress, she speaks directly to the camera. Aerial shots of the Maldives appear, showing overwater villas arranged in a circular pattern and long wooden walkways over the clear sea. (7) A close-up shows a black suitcase on a tiled floor. A hand holds an iPhone displaying a QR code for eSIM activation. (8) The woman is seen in a yellow pleated dress spinning on a wooden pier, and later in a red bikini holding a glass of iced tea and wearing a lifebuoy. (9) Final shot of the woman in the pink dress giving two thumbs up, followed by her running on the beach in her red bikini with her arms wide toward the horizon.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, enthusiastic female voice speaking quickly against a bright, upbeat electronic pop BGM. Her energy is high, culminating in a dramatic scream. (2) A comical slide-whistle SFX plays as she mimics falling, followed by a brief laughter sound. (3) The narration transitions to a friendly, informative tone, describing her vacation. The BGM remains consistent with a steady, driving beat around 128 BPM. (4) Digital UI 'ding' and 'click' sound effects are synchronized with the appearance of the iPhone screen and QR code, emphasizing technical steps. (5) The female voice maintains a high pitch and clear articulation throughout the pitch about roaming costs, using vocal stress to highlight the '390,000' figure. (6) The video concludes with her speaking warmly, inviting the audience to prepare for their trips, ending with a clean audio cut as the music swells slightly.
